description: Selected fields transcribed from the cited GitHub Actions public Stonk API diagnostic logs. This extract distinguishes quote registry observation, token catalogue timestamps, launch-record timestamps and practical UI availability. It is not proof of a completed website launch or a full historical replay.

jeanphil.reason: No independently recovered before/after website-readiness or quote-pricing snapshots. The catalogue contains earlier token/launch records than the previously discussed 15:56 UTC visibility observation, so that observation cannot establish a 30-minute activation delay.

pepe.reason: No historical registry-first-seen and blocked-to-working launch/pricing pair of observations was recovered. Multiple catalogue entries share a timestamp while their launch records have earlier differing timestamps.

blackberry.reason: This archived test measured catalogue ordering, not historical website availability or a pricing-status transition.

fttOngoingCase.elapsedMeaning: Approximately 2h20m between a bot registry-observation timestamp and a later failed pricing check. NOT a measured completed activation wait, NOT proof of uninterrupted downtime, NOT the original registry creation time.

studyLimitations: No completed historical registered-but-blocked to website-launchable interval was established for PEPE, JEANPHIL or BlackBerry.
Differences between launch.createdAt and token.createdAt are timestamp differences, not measured quote activation delays or guaranteed live indexing-latency measurements.

Current existence in Stonk's catalogue and a launch record do not alone show that the token was created through the public website rather than an adopted external launch; they are not end-to-end UI tests.

Repeated catalogue timestamps are consistent with batch registration/indexing, but the internal implementation and exact time each row first became publicly readable were not independently established.
Oldest token-page ordering with tied timestamps does not establish exact first-ever launch order.
There is no defensible sample median, mean, normal range or FTT opening-time forecast from these observations.
No production bot code, Telegram configuration or on-chain state was changed in this investigation; diagnostic files were written only on the existing nondeploying branch.
